doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: Closing thanks and Emmy nominations
summary: Rowe thanks Gluck and wishes him an Emmy; both say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you speak very eloquently about your craft and art. And I appreciate your time. I think this is a really valuable session for musicians and potential engineers. And I want to thank you for your time and I hope that you land that second Emmy.

Emmy. Fine. Thank you. I’m looking at three Emmy nominations here. Those have always been bridesmaids, never a bride. But we’ll see what happens. There’s always time to do that. Thank you so much for the invite to do this, it was really wonderful. Thank you.
Well thank you and I’ll pause here and we’ll say our good-byes.
Best wishes to you for your future career.
Thank you, and with everything else you’re doing.
